listing.name: Final Fantasy Tactics Advance (FFTA Recomp)
listing.summary: Final Fantasy Tactics Advance recompiled for Windows and Linux, using your own USA GBA ROM.

steps.title: Use your own supported USA original
steps.instruction: On first Play, choose your own Final Fantasy Tactics Advance USA GBA ROM (AFXE, SHA-1 4ac05441f4de70a4ec3dd932116346c61b8783d9) in the player's file picker. The player rejects other files after selection and remembers the path in rom.cfg, so keep the ROM where it is. Save-state slots are written beside that ROM with .stateN names. The package includes the clean-room emibios replacement, so no Nintendo BIOS dump is needed.

steps.title: Run a copy you manage yourself
steps.instruction: Keep the complete package for your system together. Start FFTARecomp.exe on Windows, or the FFTARecomp AppImage on Linux, from its own folder; the launch screen and game run in one process. To add that copy to Portcove, select the player and its folder with no extra arguments, then choose Play.

warnings: The project uses the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0; observe its noncommercial terms. The package also includes retail box art that the project license does not cover. Portcove downloads it only from the project’s own releases. You need your own original game files.
This upstream preview is experimental. Portcove has not observed native setup, gameplay or saves, and no compatibility of saves or save states across versions is claimed.

references.title: Keep saves, settings and external states
references.instruction: The battery save is saves/ffta_us.sav beside the player unless --save or --save-path points elsewhere. rom.cfg, bios.cfg, skip_launcher_on_boot, config.ini and keybinds.ini also sit beside the player, and imported mods go to mods/packages with mods/state.toml. Save-state slots live beside your ROM, or in the --state-dir folder. Back up all of these before replacing a copy you manage yourself.

presentation.manual_preparation: On first Play, choose your own Final Fantasy Tactics Advance USA GBA ROM in the player's file picker; the player rejects other files and remembers the path in rom.cfg, so keep the ROM where it is. Portcove keeps the battery save in saves, the launcher and input settings (rom.cfg, bios.cfg, skip_launcher_on_boot, config.ini, keybinds.ini), imported mods in mods/packages with mods/state.toml, and the diagnostic files it writes beside itself (hang_dump.log, hang_fp_tail.csv, hang_trace.csv and its recompilation coverage reports) across updates, backups and rollback. Save-state slots are written beside your ROM, outside the managed copy, and are not backed up or rewound by Portcove. Portcove starts the player with its runtime self-heal compiler turned off, so it never compiles or loads extra code inside the managed copy; the game falls back to its built-in interpreter for any uncompiled code. The package includes the clean-room emibios replacement, so no Nintendo BIOS dump is needed.
